offline: You are offline. These are the last confirmed details. Reconnect to refresh status or continue to payment.
error: The current status could not be checked. Refresh before continuing to payment.
unavailable: This order is no longer available to this account.
deadlineUnknown: Reservation deadline is unavailable. Refresh to check the current order status.
expired: The server reports that this reservation expired. This order cannot be paid.
elapsed: The reservation time has elapsed on this device. Refresh to confirm the order status.
deviceClock: Countdown uses this device’s clock; the server confirms availability.
paymentUnavailable: Payment is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
notPayable: Payment cannot be started for this order in its current state.
